hookLine: Ranking the wildest VR headset fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Swinging blind and slamming himself straight into the wall.
Number 4: Losing all balance and crashing flat onto the floor.
Number 3: Backing up and knocking the picture frame clean off the wall.
Number 2: Spinning out and collapsing in a heap by the couch.
Number 1: One wild swing and the entire TV gets ripped off the wall!

outroLine: Never play VR near furniture. Subscribe!
